scope: Maintainer primary implementation documentation, not exhaustive literature novelty review.

findings.claim: fplll provides floating-point LLL variants and a wrapper choosing a sequence with guaranteed output.
findings.consequence: Exact GMP LLL in our prototype is not the strongest implementation reference. Use pinned fplll wrapper/proved arm before fastest-specialized claims.

findings.claim: Documentation offers unimodular-transform output and guaranteed weakened delta/eta for wrapper/proved settings.
findings.consequence: Independently validate lattice membership/determinant, range certificate and exact resulting output; numerical reduction is discovery only, so an approximate reducer cannot exclude roots without exact replay.

findings.claim: The default documentation names LLL82, NS09, MSV09 and Stehle09.
findings.consequence: LLL reduction and exact lattice basis changes are classical; present field/chart construction as a hypothesis, no novelty certification.

bounded_next_experiment.mechanism: fplll discovers short vectors, exact replay proves exclusion; non-certifying results fall back to complete fixed-h solver
bounded_next_experiment.input: New disjoint post-result training block ladder fixed before timings, all five NIST fields, width8/16/32, all contexts retained
bounded_next_experiment.metrics: Full conditional all-u union; setup, executable startup, reduction, exact replay, survivor solves, serialization, wall and per-process peak RSS; compare same-output all-h baseline
bounded_next_experiment.promotion: Only if complete identical conditional unions and lower paid whole-arm costs; release remains separately unqualified
